content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Periyar University Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Periyar University, located in Salem, Tamil Nadu, for a contractual research project position under ICSSR sponsorship.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post in this recruitment notification is Field Investigator, aimed at supporting research activities within the university department.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Field Investigator post under advertisement number 140/2024-25/ICSSR/RP/MJ/GEN.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for Periyar University Field Investigator Recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 09-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates need to send their resumes and required documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Postgraduate degree in a Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants applying for this role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 30 years as per the official recruitment notification guidelines for the post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or stipend offered for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Field Investigator position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply for this job?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates applying for this post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for Periyar University Field Investigator Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Field Investigator position will be made purely on the basis of an interview conducted by the university.
